facts.material: 100% nylon knit lace outer; 100% polyester knit liner

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 6104 covers women's knitted dresses; chapter 61 notes do not exclude
GRI 3(b)/essential character: nylon lace outer dress gives the essential character, liner treated as a lining
GRI 6: 6104.43 synthetic fibers, 6104.43.20 other (not wool), .10 women's

rejected_alternatives.reason: slip of man-made fibers; only if the slip is a separate garment presented as a set with the dress (as in I84334 where slip was separable)
applies only to dresses containing 23% or more wool or fine animal hair

missing_facts: Whether the slip is sewn-in lining or a separable garment (I84334 classified a separable dress and slip separately)
classification.rationale: Knit dress of synthetic fibers falls in 6104.43 and, having no wool, 6104.43.20.10 women's. The polyester liner is treated as an integral lining. I84334 shows that a separable slip would be classified separately in 6108.11.
